downgraded_claims_principle: any claim whose only support is 'clicked coordinate X, panel Y appeared' is a COORDINATE fact, not a STATE fact; state labels require independently read identity evidence (title text, layout role, or verified round-trip navigation)
unknowns_added: U5: identity of the post-allocation panel (技能解放 / 技能树 / other) — coordinates known, semantics not proven
U6: whether the panel blocks 決定 by being OPEN, or by an incomplete required skill SELECTION (F6 stays, mechanism UNKNOWN)
U7: identity of UNKNOWN_SELECTION_OVERLAY_073000 (support member? unit edit? other) — only its 戻る exit is verified
U8: whether 振り返り (reflection) is reachable in this flow at all — never observed
recommended_schema_changes: SC1: state labels for overlays must carry an identity_source field: 'title_text_read' | 'roundtrip_verified' | 'coordinate_only'; coordinate_only labels must be prefixed UNIDENTIFIED_
SC2: separate observed_screen (geometry/URL facts) from semantic_state (named game state); a screenshot artifact maps 1:1 to observed_screen, semantic_state is always an inference with confidence
SC3: panel/modal records need parent_screen + open_trigger + close_action fields so sub-panels cannot be silently merged into parents
SC4: never_observed list should be maintained explicitly in environment_map_progress.json to prevent legacy-code concepts (e.g., 振り返り) from leaking into state labels without evidence
